narr: High pressure centered over The Four Corners area brought a moist southerly flow over northern Arizona. This allowed thunderstorms with heavy rain to form over parts of northern Arizona resulting in several flash floods.
ev: The wash along Paradise Road flooded.
Havasu Creek at Supai rose 18 inches in about an hour. It took six hours for the creek to return to normal.
The Bright Angel Trail in the Grand Canyon was washed out by a flash flood.
Water was flowing and estimated two feet deep over Stagecoach Road where it crosses Groom Creek.
Lewis Street in Williams was flooded.
Social media post indicated road flooding in Fort Defiance.
The river gauge on the Agua Fria River near Humboldt measured a 6 foot rise.
